title: Restricting a positively expansive map keeps it positively expansive
outcome: Proved, under one reading of the wording
summary: On a torsion abelian group, the restriction of a positively expansive endomorphism to an invariant subgroup is positively expansive.
source: M. Achigar, "Algebraic expansivity on abelian groups", arXiv:2604.24556v1 (27 April 2026), the conjecture closing the paper.
label: lean
new: fairly sure; the proof is short
